lead: Every DOM VIRUS game, its embeds and this site are all rights reserved, copyright 2026 Chris Cooley. Only the Fizlet engine package, @fzlt/core, is open source under the MIT licence. One icon outline carries its own ISC licence, listed below. Last updated 2026-11-20.

body.text: You may play the games where Chris Cooley makes them available. Copying, changing, hosting, embedding or selling a game, its art or its names needs written permission.

The Fizlet engine package, @fzlt/core, is MIT: you may use, copy, change and share it, keeping the copyright line and the licence text. Copies of a game already published under MIT stay MIT for whoever has one.

items.title: DOM VIRUS runtime inside the games
items.body: Sherman Bytes, Byte Runner and Null Invaders each bundle the DOM VIRUS runtime. Each game's own LICENSE covers it, and none has a third-party runtime dependency.

items.title: Site artwork notice
items.body: The hub's ship, runner, fly and tank artwork follows the games' own renderers. Its notice includes the Lucide licence text.

items.title: React (optional)
items.body: The optional React adapter imports React from your own app. React is not included in any game.

items.title: Fonts
items.body: No fonts are bundled. The site and games use fonts already on your device.
